The '''Sergeant-at-Arms''' or '''Sergeant at Arms''' was an official with [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] and administrative responsibilities in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and later the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] and was charged with the maintenance of order on the floor of the [[Grand Convocation Chamber|chamber]].

==Duties==
The Sergeant at Arms was responsible for maintaining order during sessions and to maintain security and protocol in the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]]. They sat in the central pod below the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] and [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] Senate also had a Sergeant at Arms.

==History==
By [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], [[Mif Kumas]] had been Sergeant at Arms of the New Republic Senate for two terms.
